newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: Lithuanian finance minister to resign-agency.
newsitem.headline: Lithuanian finance minister to resign-agency.

text.p: Lithuanian Finance Minister Rolandas Matiliauskas submitted his resignation to the government on Thursday, the Baltic News Service (BNS) said.
The news agency quoted Matiliauskas as saying in a letter that he was resigning over allegations that he wrongfully took a loan from a commercial bank.
Matiliauskas, 29, became finance minister late last year after the right-wing government of Prime Minister Gediminas Vagnorius swept former Communists from power.
Allegations immediately surfaced that Matiliauskas gained a soft loan from a commercial bank where he worked which later went bankrupt.
Matiliauskas's letter of resignation said that he did not want to damage the government and sought to end "political speculation", a government spokesman told Reuters.
The spokesman said that Vagnorius would now consider whether to accept the finance minister's resignation.
